November 3-Round Swiss

November 15, 2026

Publix - Community Room · 10250 Staples Mill Rd · Glen Allen, VA 23060 Map
Register Entry List

Description: November rated 3-Round Swiss

Location: Publix, Community Room @ 10250 Staples Mill Rd, Glen Allen, VA 23060. The Community Room is upstairs once you enter Publix. Notice: In order to support Publix hosting this event, outside food is not permitted. Please support your local Publix instead and buy food onsite!

Dates: November 15th (Look out for our following tournament and Christmas bake-off coming on December 27th!)

Format: This event will be a 3-round Swiss, G/60 D10, Regular rated event. Round 1: 9:30am, Round 2: 12:30pm, Round 3: 3:00pm. Rounds may begin early if all participants are willing and present. USCF registration is mandatory to participate for prizes, and can be done on-site.

Entry fee: $40 if pre-registered, $50 after midnight and onsite. $60 for late entries. Participants U1200 may pay an extra $10 to "play-up" in the Open section.
Final registration closes at 9:00am to start the tournament on time. The director must be notified at 801-347-9233.

Prizes, scaled up or down based on registration of 18 players:
Open: 1st $200, 2nd $100

U1200: 1st $150, 2nd $75


Byes: Allowed, please contact director for advanced notice. Byes will forfeit tiebreaks for prizes.

If any questions, please email Michael Munafo at kids4chess@gmail.com, (801)-347-9233

For club information and future tournaments, visit kids4chess.com/upcoming-tournaments
